Players Committee gallery image of [[E-web Blaster]], present in the capture of 29 November 2007 at 10:54:50 UTC. A bronze round mark is visible at the lower right. The complete image retains its published black matte and drop shadow.

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071129105450id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/hoth/ds/ewebblaster.gif exact PC gallery capture]. This establishes that the image was available by the capture time, not its first publication day.
